name: CWA Battle of the Warriors 2008

date.source: the page prints no date; the CWA's own schedule (captured February 2008) lists Battle of the Warriors for 22 January 2008 while its champions record dates Jack Spade's World title win on this card, and the New Age Dogg Pound's tag title win, to 15 January 2008, so the month is the date the record carries

matches.note: Jack wins with a Lasting Impression and a small package.
Bombshell wins with a Bitch Kick and a spear.
Dante meets Frank on the floor with a chair shot and the referee calls for the bell; the commentary gives Frank the match, and Dante lays him out with the ring steps before he leaves.
Bart Phillips hits Mrs. Robinson by mistake with his chair and Hoshi wins. Not a tournament bout: the commentary asks what happened to the tournament.

Horace chairs Max and Dante is announced the winner by disqualification. Not a tournament bout: Max Cameron has no first-round match on the card and the final is drawn from the three first-round winners.
Frank Merritt wins with a Heart Punch and is the million-dollar man.
6Pac wins the three-way.

matches.title: cwa-revival-2007-tag-team
matches.note: Frank Merritt, the night’s new millionaire, clears the ring until the Coopers spear and slam him and a Cooper is slammed onto him for the pin; the New Age Dogg Pound win the tag titles and 6Pac Dudley celebrates with them.

matches.stipulation: CWA title, The Moose the guest referee
matches.title: cwa-revival-2007-world
matches.note: Jack Spade is the new CWA champion.

notes: Battle of the Warriors 2008 is another million-dollar tournament: Jack Spade, Bombshell and Frank Merritt win the first round and Frank Merritt wins the three-way final over Bombshell and Jack Spade to be the million-dollar man. The New Age Dogg Pound win the tag titles in a three-team match, 6Pac Dudley is handed the Aerial title when Bombshell walks out before their match, and the main event, a three-way with The Moose as guest referee, makes Jack Spade the new CWA champion. Five segments headed BOTW Flashback replay bouts and segments from earlier Battles of the Warriors (among them the 2006 and 2007 finals, Sal Clemenzo’s world title win over Lethal Weapon, Stevie James against Q, and Leech and Razorblade’s tea party); none is counted as a match of this card. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Overdrive, 29 January 2008

date.source: the page's own heading, January 29th, 2008 (its title line misprints 2007)

matches.note: The Yakamoto sisters score a win over the tag team champions.
Jack Spade, who comes out holding the CWA belt, wins with a 450 splash.
Tommy wins with the Tommyknocker.

appearances.note: Kannon's open invitation: he presses Kelly Buchanan overhead and throws her into the ring; Halloween Jack's run-in is stopped by Kira Yakamoto with a lead pipe and no result is called.
Pulled into Kannon's invitational match by Mr. Rivers; the bell sounds but no result is stated.

notes: Overdrive in the revived CWA: Jack Spade carries the CWA title, New Age Dogg Pound are the tag champions. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Overdrive, 25 March 2008

matches.note: Kelly Buchanan comes out alone, her partner Lady Eagle nowhere to be seen; Hoshi wins with the Perfect 10.
Police walk Frank Merritt out in handcuffs after a rematch of sorts has started; the referee calls for the bell and Dex Cooper is announced the winner by forfeit.
Bombshell submits.
Tommy wins with Des's help.
6Pac, who tosses his belt to the timekeeper, wins with a school boy.

notes: Overdrive two weeks after Sex and Violence took the tag titles. Dex Cooper's match with Frank Merritt is stopped when police walk Frank out. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.

name: CWA Overdrive, 26 April 2008

matches.note: Hoshi wins with a victory roll on Kelly.

Kannon attacks Max on the ramp and Eli Ryder runs out to save him; tables, a kendo stick and a fire extinguisher are used. Frank Merritt clotheslines Max and drives the extinguisher into his throat; Eli Ryder, unaware, hits the Disasterpiece and pins Max. Kannon was in the match throughout and is not the pinned man.

matches.title: cwa-revival-2007-world
matches.note: Jack Spade retains, pinning 6Pac Dudley with the Jack of All Spades after tossing Tommy out.

notes: Overdrive with Jack Spade still the CWA champion. Not every segment of the card is structured here; the served page is the whole record.
